location: POWER PLANT - CLOSE ON MAN'S BODY
summary: A man's body floats in a magenta amnion inside a capsule, spasming against the thick gelatin with tubes obscuring his face and lines connected to his limbs. He struggles desperately, unable to breathe, clawing at the thinning elastic shroud until it ruptures around his mouth and he tears himself free from the cell. He is revealed to be Neo, bald and naked, slick with gelatin, dizzy and nauseous, waiting for his vision to focus. He discovers an enormous coaxial cable plugged and locked into the base of his skull, and cannot remove it. He sees other pods filled with magenta gelatin containing pale, motionless human beings, arranged in circles fanning out to a center core, with towers of glowing petals spiraling up to incomprehensible heights and down into a dim murk. A machine drops in front of him, seizes him and paralyzes him as the cable lock spins and opens. The cable disengages, a needle and cerebrum-chip slide from his skull with blood and spinal fluid, and the other hoses snap free. The back of the unit opens and a tremendous vacuum sucks the gelatin and Neo into a black hole.

what_changes.before: A body trapped and submerged in a magenta amnion, fighting blindly against the gelatin, unable to breathe
what_changes.after: Emerged from the cell, bald and naked, standing in the capsule and able to suck for air
what_changes.evidence: clawing at the thinning elastic shroud, until it ruptures, a hole widening around his mouth as he sucks for air. Tearing himself free, he emerges from the cell.

what_changes.before: An anonymous struggling body, his identity hidden by tubes and gelatin
what_changes.after: Becomes aware that he is Neo and that he, along with countless others, is one of many human beings held as motionless pods in an immense power plant
what_changes.evidence: To either sides he sees other tube-shaped pods filled with magenta gelatin; beneath the wax-like surface, pale and motionless, he sees other human beings.

what_changes.before: Physically plugged into the capsule, with a coaxial locked into his skull and IVs grafted to his flesh that he cannot remove
what_changes.after: Disconnected by the machine, with the needle and cerebrum-chip slid from his skull and the hoses snapped free, then sucked out of the unit
what_changes.evidence: The machine seizes hold of Neo, paralyzing him as the cable lock at the back of his neck spins and opens. The cable disengages itself.

event_hint.one_line: Neo is forcibly reborn out of his human-battery pod, sees the vast scale of the machine-run power plant, and is then disconnected and vacuumed out by a machine.

objects_that_matter: the oval capsule of clear alloy
the coaxial cable locked into the base of Neo's skull
the other pods with human beings
the center core and towers of glowing petals
the clear plastic needle and cerebrum-chip
uncertain: Whether the machine's disconnection of Neo is meant to free him or to harvest him.
Where the black hole sucks Neo to.
